meta.title: Wetherspoons Edinburgh: pubs, menu and prices guide
meta.description: Explore Wetherspoons Edinburgh with pub locations, menu favourites and practical price advice. Compare areas and find where to check before you order.

intro:
This guide covers {pubCount} open Wetherspoons pubs in Edinburgh across {areaCount} areas: New Town, Leith Walk and Old Town. Every pub works from the national [Wetherspoons menu](/), but prices are set locally. Use it to choose a location, compare the national menu options and understand why your bill can differ between pubs.

You will also find breakfast guidance, club days and practical ordering advice. SpoonsMenu is an independent guide and is not affiliated with J D Wetherspoon plc.
quickAnswer: We list {pubCount} open Wetherspoons pubs in Edinburgh across {areaCount} areas. New Town has The Standing Order and The Alexander Graham Bell, both on George Street. The Playfair is at the Omni Centre on Leith Walk, while The Booking Office is on Waverley Bridge in Old Town. Check your chosen pub for current menu prices.

areas.text: New Town has The Standing Order and The Alexander Graham Bell, both on George Street. These are the listed options if you want to eat in this area. Compare each pub's current menu prices before choosing, rather than assuming the same order will cost the same at both.

The Playfair is the listed Wetherspoons option for Leith Walk, at the Omni Centre. It suits visitors who have chosen this area and want a named pub to check before heading out. Confirm current food availability and prices with the pub rather than relying solely on the national menu.

The Booking Office is the listed Wetherspoons pub in Old Town, with its address on Waverley Bridge. It is the option in this guide for anyone planning to eat in that area. Check the pub's current menu before settling on a dish or comparing its prices with other locations.

pricing:
Wetherspoons menu prices in Edinburgh vary by pub, even though the menu is broadly the same nationally. Any price shown in a guide should be treated as typical, not a fixed amount for every location.

City centre pubs often charge more than suburban pubs, so a central location can affect what you pay. That does not establish which of the listed pubs is cheapest: compare the same dish at each before deciding.

For an exact current price, check the menu at your chosen pub or select that location in the Wetherspoon app. National menu favourites include [burgers](/burgers), curries, fish and chips and pizza, but confirm local availability before ordering.
breakfastAndClubs:
Breakfast is typically served from eight in the morning until noon, while [Curry Club](/curry-club) is traditionally on Thursday and [Steak Club](/steak-club) on Tuesday at participating pubs. These are general Wetherspoons timings and club days, not confirmation of the arrangements at every Edinburgh location.

The traditional breakfast is among the dishes on the national menu. If breakfast or a club meal is the reason for your visit, check the chosen pub's current menu and participation first. You can order at the bar or at your table using the Wetherspoon app.
